content.text: That worked — completing the remaining clear-up orders.

arguments: {"hazard":"H3","instruction_en":"Move the cable at the Hallway door off the walkway and secure it along the wall.","instruction_zh":"將走廊門口的電線移離走道，沿牆邊固定收好。"}

name: draft_work_order

name: draft_work_order
